title: Owner locator + mini burn lookup (Apr 2026)
content:
Purpose: quick cross-functional owner lookup and rough effort (burn) estimate for one-off coverage tasks or short-lived handoffs. Use for weekend patches, short rollouts, and triage snapshots.

How to use (fast):
- Find the nearest owner by skill + timezone.
- Use Est. Burn as a 2-3 point guess (low/typical/high) for planning quick coverage swaps.
- Confidence = eyeball (H/M/L). If L, ping the collaborator listed.

Table (rows are lightweight):
Owner | Role | Primary channel | Coverage window (UTC) | Est. burn (hrs) | Confidence | Quick notes / constraints | Escalation (next person)
Aisha Patel | Product-ops lead | Slack @aisha | 06:00-18:00 UTC | 2 / 4 / 6 | H | Prefers short handoffs, can triage billing/quotas | Priya Nair
Diego Morales | SRE (runtime) | PagerDuty / Slack | 00:00-08:00 UTC | 3 / 6 / 9 | M | Can pull traces, may need infra quota increase (see OPS-3421) | Samir Gupta
Maya Chen | Release engineer | Email + Slack | 12:00-22:00 UTC | 1 / 2 / 3 | H | Good for canary rollouts and rollback prep | Aisha Patel
Samir Gupta | Support lead | Zendesk / Slack | 08:00-20:00 UTC | 1 / 3 / 5 | H | Handles customer escalations and billing questions | Diego Morales
Elena Rossi | Solutions Eng | Slack DM / calendar | 14:00-02:00 UTC | 1 / 2 / 4 | M | Deep product context for enterprise customers | Maya Chen

Mini calculations / examples:
- If feature toggle rollout needs coverage for a 36-hour window spanning two shifts: sum typical burn across two owners + 20% overhead. E.g., Maya (typical 2) + Diego (typical 6) + 20% = 9.6 hrs (round to 10).
- Quick surge: assign lowest-latency owner and mark L1 escalation path in Slack thread.

Open questions (to resolve before final handoff):
- Can Diego be assigned burst GPUs without SRE approval? (see linked PR for quota flow)
- Which on-call rota covers the customer-facing timezone overnight (APAC) next week?

Next steps / triage checklist: 
1) Confirm primary owner in Slack channel and thread (tag).
2) Create short Handoff note in Confluence page linked above (copy-paste table row).
3) Create a minimal Jira task if burn > 4 hrs or customer impact > P2.
4) Add estimated hours to weekly ops sync agenda if multiple one-offs accumulate.

Notes to self: keep this sheet lean. Replace rows with owners rotating quarterly. If confidence L, mark "requires pairing" and set a 30-min sync.

Revision history: created 2026-04-02 by Aisha Patel. Minor owner updates 2026-04-05 (added Elena + adjusted Diego window).
